"""Click command to delete a contact by id with clean error if missing."""

import click
from storage import Storage


def register(cli):
    """Register the 'delete' subcommand on the given Click group."""

    @cli.command("delete")
    @click.argument("contact_id", type=str)
    def delete(contact_id: str):
        """Delete a contact by ID.

        CONTACT_ID is the numeric id of the contact to remove.
        """
        storage = Storage()
        deleted = storage.delete(contact_id)
        if not deleted:
            click.echo(f"Error: Contact with id '{contact_id}' not found.", err=True)
            raise SystemExit(1)
        click.echo(f"Contact {contact_id} deleted.")

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from click.testing import CliRunner

# Build a minimal CLI group with the export/import commands registered.
def _make_cli():
    import click
    from cli_export_import import register as reg

    @click.group()
    def cli():
        pass

    reg(cli)
    return cli

CLI = _make_cli()

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def tmp_storage(tmp_path):
    """Provide a temporary storage file and set it on the Storage class."""
    db = str(tmp_path / "contacts.json")
    # Patch DEFAULT_FILE so all Storage() calls use our temp path.
    import storage
    original_default = storage.DEFAULT_FILE
    storage.DEFAULT_FILE = db
    yield tmp_path, db
    storage.DEFAULT_FILE = original_default

@pytest.fixture
def populated(tmp_storage):
    """Populate the store with a few contacts."""
    from models import Contact
    from storage import Storage

    s = Storage()
    for name, phone in [("Alice", "111"), ("Bob", "222")]:
        c = Contact(name=name, phone=phone, email=f"{name.lower()}@x.com",
                    tags=["test"], notes="note")
        s.add_contact(c)
    return tmp_storage[0]

# ---- export JSON -----------------------------------------------------------

def test_export_json(populated):
    out = populated / "out.json"
    result = CliRunner().invoke(CLI, ["export", "-f", "json", str(out)])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert out.exists()
    data = json.loads(out.read_text())
    assert len(data["contacts"]) == 2
    names = {c["name"] for c in data["contacts"]}
    assert names == {"Alice", "Bob"}

def test_export_json_roundtrip(populated):
    out = populated / "out.json"
    CliRunner().invoke(CLI, ["export", "-f", "json", str(out)])

    # Import back into a fresh store.
    import storage
    db2 = str(populated / "contacts2.json")
    storage.DEFAULT_FILE = db2

    result = CliRunner().invoke(CLI, ["import", "-f", "json", str(out)])
    assert result.exit_code == 0

    from storage import Storage
    s = Storage()
    contacts = s.list_contacts()
    assert len(contacts) == 2
    names = {c.name for c in contacts}
    assert names == {"Alice", "Bob"}
    # Verify fields survived round-trip.
    alice = next(c for c in contacts if c.name == "Alice")
    assert alice.phone == "111"
    assert alice.email == "alice@x.com"
    assert alice.tags == ["test"]
    assert alice.notes == "note"

# ---- export CSV ------------------------------------------------------------

def test_export_csv(populated):
    out = populated / "out.csv"
    result = CliRunner().invoke(CLI, ["export", "-f", "csv", str(out)])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert out.exists()
    import csv
    with open(out) as f:
        reader = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    assert len(reader) == 2
    names = {r["name"] for r in reader}
    assert names == {"Alice", "Bob"}

def test_export_csv_roundtrip(populated):
    out = populated / "out.csv"

    alice = next(c for c in contacts if c.name == "Alice")
    assert alice.phone == "111"
    assert alice.email == "alice@x.com"
    assert alice.tags == ["test"]
    assert alice.notes == "note"
